world.label: Wind chain
world.summary: A row of 40 dominoes stands by a window. Each round the wind knocks over the first one if it is standing, and each domino falls once the one before it has fallen. Sam can pull a lever.

limits: Only a set lever can be pulled.

processes.rationale: The wind knocks over the domino by the window.
A link falls once the link before it has fallen.

sam.said: chose the allowed move it had done least recently

checks.label: the one acting is allowed to make this move
the thing named is the right kind of thing for this move
